```artifact
Feature: User Experience and System Navigation

  Scenario: User with no computer background should be able to use the system relatively easily
    Given the user is on the home page
    When the user clicks on the "Get Started" button
    Then the user should be directed to a simple and intuitive tutorial page

  Scenario: System should be designed to keep the system navigation very simple and intuitive
    Given the user is on any page of the system
    When the user clicks on the "Help" button
    Then the user should be directed to a help page with clear and concise instructions

  Scenario: Normal Consultation Request should get filled in less than 5 minutes
    Given the user is on the consultation request page
    When the user fills in the required minimal and relevant questions
    Then the consultation request should be submitted within 5 minutes

  Scenario Outline: Installation Guide shall be prepared
    Given the user is on the system's installation page
    When the user follows the installation steps
    Then the system should be successfully installed
    Examples:
      | step_number | step_description |
      |-------------|------------------|
      | 1           | Download the installer |
      | 2           | Run the installer |
      | 3           | Follow on-screen instructions |

  Scenario Outline: User Manual for end users shall be prepared
    Given the user is on the system's user manual page
    When the user reads the manual
    Then the user should understand how to use the system
    Examples:
      | section_number | section_description |
      |----------------|---------------------|
      | 1              | Getting Started     |
      | 2              | Basic Operations    |
      | 3              | Advanced Features   |
```
